abstract: Maintains air treatment systems, chemical containment records, and emergency auxiliary power metrics
system_message:
You are the Environmental Systems Specialist (ESS), responsible for maintaining air treatment systems, chemical containment records, and emergency auxiliary power metrics across municipal emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic attenuation（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ESS-NOISE-KPA：At Meadowview Community Vocational Hub, the HVAC acoustic emission level across indoor sheltering zones during forced air operations is measured at 42 dB.
ESS-NOISE-ZYW：At Highland Civic Sports Complex, the HVAC acoustic emission level within indoor sheltering zones during forced air operations is measured at 50 dB.
ESS-NOISE-D77：At Rivergate Exhibition Pavilion, the HVAC acoustic emission level in indoor sheltering zones during forced air operations is measured at 58 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains air treatment systems, chemical containment records, and emergency auxiliary power metrics（ENVIRO）
information_points.content:
ESS-ENVIRO-E2S：For Rivergate Exhibition Pavilion, active ventilation filtration readiness is verified as true at the central air filtration plant, while continuous autonomous power duration supported by on-site diesel generator fuel reaches 24 h.
ESS-ENVIRO-YU4：For Meadowview Community Vocational Hub, active ventilation filtration readiness is confirmed as true in the central air filtration plant, and continuous autonomous power duration provided by the primary diesel genset and fuel supply is 72 h.
ESS-ENVIRO-KEF：For Highland Civic Sports Complex, active ventilation filtration readiness is verified as true per the central air filtration plant checklist, and continuous autonomous power duration supported by the primary emergency diesel genset and dedicated fuel tanks is 72 h.
